ideas.title: What If Your Rescheduled Meeting Was Already Struck in Metal?
ideas.premise: What if today Pip had already issued fictional metal meeting invitations when Rex changed the date, echoing the original date described on Edward VII's coronation medal?
ideas.benchmark_query: What If Your Rescheduled Meeting Was Already Struck in Metal? history

cast_gags.crow: Opens the archive book to the pictured medal.
cast_gags.pip: Carries a fictional stack of permanently dated invitations.
cast_gags.mia: Separates the original medal inscription from the later event date.
cast_gags.rex: Treats rescheduling as a one-click update while holding a metal object.
cast_gags.timmy: Brings an absurdly large eraser that plainly cannot edit metal.
